_comment: Update pointer for the 'Update Library' flow. A device fetches this file, compares latest.libraryVersion to its installed catalog, and (if newer) downloads latest.url (the catalog manifest), then fetches each board listed in manifest.boards in order, validates them, and loads them via loadLibrary(boards, { libraryVersion }).

latest.notes: Minor: R2 Uppity Spinner ALT updated for firmware 4.0.0-beta.1 (the v4 rewrite; it keeps every v3 :P/#P command). Added: #PRESUME (release a latched E-STOP), #PSTATE, #PCLEARFAULT, #PROTARYTEST<turns>, #PRANDOMLIGHT<mode> (new enum uppity.randomLight) and #PMESHHB<seconds>. :PX and :PH keep their ids and templates with names that say what they do on v4 (:PX latches; :PH lowers safely, homing the head first). The six new commands are marked (v4); #PRC (RC/PPM mode) is kept and marked v3 only: v4 has no RC input and ignores it. The board's routing note describes v4. No ids removed or renamed; other boards unchanged.
